posts.text:
🥩 THE MEAT GRINDER IS COMING 🥩 SPLORCH!

Opens at block 977,220 (about 11 AM Central today, Mon Nov 23).

Pets rotting in your Discard pile? Don't let them go to waste. GRIND THEM. 🐸🔪

🎰 ONE burn of 69 XCPETS grinds up to 2,000 pets from your Discard pile.
🍖 Meat per pet: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 5, Legendary 20.
🎡 Every 250 meat = a FREE Pepe Wheel spin.
🌭 Every 1,000 meat = a Sausage Egg that is NEVER Common (60% Uncommon, 32% Rare, 8% Legendary).
✨ Every grind rolls for a GOLDEN SAUSAGE: a sure Legendary! 1% per 200 pets ground, up to 10%.

🚫 Too powerful for the hopper: Gods, Mythics, Bitcoin Wizards, tokenized pets, one of a kinds, and pets in the shop, on a quest or in Cold Storage.
⚠️ Ground pets are gone for good.

Find it in My Pets > More > Care > Meat Grinder. Feed the machine. xcpets.fun
